name: TestFontRoboto

source.verification: Release asset of googlefonts/roboto-3-classic v3.016 (2026-06-17); its SHA-256 matches the GitHub release asset digest. hinted/static/Roboto-Regular, -Medium, -Light, -Bold, -Black, -Italic, -BoldItalic, -BlackItalic and RobotoCondensed-Bold, -BoldItalic (.ttf) were extracted byte for byte from the archive. The archive has no license file, so OFL.txt was taken from the same tag (raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/roboto-3-classic/v3.016/OFL.txt).

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.

The faces besides Regular are the typefaces of the UE 5.8 editor composite font (LegacySlateFontInfoCache.cpp lines 111-122; RobotoCondensed-Bold is UE Roboto-BoldCondensed) that the UiDemo widget gallery shows (Docs/Design/UiToolkit section 16.3); they stay test data until the engine default font asset (font design FT3) exists.
